title: Paired landing route
lead: Serve a real page at `/` for paired devices, so a successful pairing no longer ends on a 404.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the Today view, mark-made and skip controls, the list link (S22 replaces this page's body and keeps the URL); the PWA manifest (S08).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `pair_submit` redirects to `/` (`src/larder/web/auth_views.py`, `redirect("/", code=303)`), and the header link in `base.html` points at `/`, but no route serves `/`. A paired device gets the 404 page. Every pairing check from S08 to S21, and an installed icon, ends there until S22 lands.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None. The placeholder wording is "You're paired".

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/web/home_views.py` (blueprint `home`, route `GET /`, endpoint `home.index`)
- `src/larder/web/templates/home.html`
- `src/larder/planner_db.py` (SQL: `meal_on(conn, day)`; S21 and S60 extend this file)
- `src/larder/web/__init__.py` (register the blueprint in `create_app`)
- `tests/test_home.py`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_home.py`, built on `WebShellTestCase` (`paired_client`):
1. `test_paired_device_gets_the_landing_page`
2. `test_unpaired_device_still_gets_401_at_root`
3. `test_landing_says_paired_when_no_plan`
4. `test_landing_shows_tonights_meal_when_planned` (patch `larder.web.home_views.today`)
5. `test_landing_ignores_other_dates_and_skipped_meals`
6. `test_pairing_redirect_lands_on_a_200_page` (follow the `Location` of a completed pairing)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `planner_db.meal_on(conn, day)`: the `planned_meal` row on that ISO date whose status is `planned`, joined to `recipe.title`; lowest id first; none returns None.
2. `home_views.today(settings)` returns `datetime.now(settings.timezone).date()` (host local time when the timezone is unset). `index()` renders `home.html` with the meal or None.
3. Register the blueprint in `create_app` after `auth_views.init_app`. The endpoint is not in `_OPEN_ENDPOINTS`, so unpaired devices keep getting the 401 page from the existing guard.
4. `home.html` extends `base.html`: a "You're paired" heading, and tonight's title when there is one. No inline script or style.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; on the dev server, completing a pairing shows the landing page, not the 404 page.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
